reading.body:
CyrusOne SAT1 is a 9 MW IT capacity data center in San Antonio, Texas. At a typical AI training density of 40 kW per rack, this would equip roughly 225 racks. The facility spans 110,000 square feet, a density of 0.082 MW per thousand square feet, consistent with a standard enterprise data center rather than a specialized AI training campus.

The campus holds certifications for compliance workloads: it qualifies to host PCI DSS, HIPAA, FISMA, and ISO 27001 classified systems. These certifications reflect security and data protection requirements, not compute intensity or AI-specific capability. The facility does not publish power density, cooling architecture, or GPU availability.

In Texas, SAT1 ranks 14th by published capacity among 19 facilities with disclosed megawatt figures. Texas has 475.41 MW of published data center IT capacity across mapped sites, and SAT1 accounts for 1.9 percent of that total. The state has 133 mapped facilities, but only 14 percent publish capacity figures, so published rankings capture only a fraction of deployed infrastructure.
